subject: Mathematics
title: Straight Lines
summary: Coordinate geometry distance aur section formulas, triangle ka area aur triangle ke centres (centroid, incentre, circumcentre, orthocentre) se shuru hoti hai. Locus nikaalna bhi yahin seekhte hain.
Line ko slope–intercept, point–slope, two-point, intercept, normal ya general form mein likh sakte hain. Slope se parallel (m₁ = m₂) aur perpendicular (m₁m₂ = −1) lines tay hoti hain.

Point ki line se distance, parallel lines ke beech distance, lines ke beech angle between, intersection se guzarne wali family of lines, concurrent lines aur angle bisectors — ye JEE ke core tools hain.

formulas.name: Distance and section
formulas.formula: d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²);  internal division m:n → ((mx₂ + nx₁)/(m + n), (my₂ + ny₁)/(m + n))

formulas.name: Area of triangle
formulas.formula: Δ = ½|x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|;  area 0 ⇔ collinear

formulas.name: Centres of a triangle
formulas.formula: centroid G = ((x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3, (y₁ + y₂ + y₃)/3);  incentre I = ((ax₁ + bx₂ + cx₃)/(a + b + c), …);  G divides OH (circumcentre O to orthocentre H) in 1:2

formulas.name: Slope
formulas.formula: m = tan θ = (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁);  parallel m₁ = m₂;  perpendicular m₁m₂ = −1

formulas.name: Forms of a line
formulas.formula: y = mx + c;  y − y₁ = m(x − x₁);  x/a + y/b = 1;  x cos α + y sin α = p;  ax + by + c = 0 (slope −a/b)

formulas.name: Angle between lines
formulas.when: Do lines ke beech acute angle.

formulas.name: Distance between parallel lines
formulas.formula: d = |c₁ − c₂|/√(a² + b²)  for ax + by + c₁ = 0 and ax + by + c₂ = 0
formulas.mistake: Pehle x aur y ke coefficients bilkul same karo — bina iske formula galat aayega.

formulas.name: Foot of perpendicular and image
formulas.formula: foot: (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = −(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²);  image: same with −2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

formulas.name: Family of lines
formulas.formula: L₁ + λL₂ = 0 passes through the intersection of L₁ = 0 and L₂ = 0
formulas.when: Intersection point se guzarne wali lines.

formulas.name: Concurrency
formulas.formula: three lines concur if the determinant |a₁ b₁ c₁; a₂ b₂ c₂; a₃ b₃ c₃| = 0

formulas.name: Angle bisectors
formulas.formula: (a₁x + b₁y + c₁)/√(a₁² + b₁²) = ±(a₂x + b₂y + c₂)/√(a₂² + b₂²)
formulas.when: Do lines ke beech ke angles ke bisectors.

formulas.name: Position of a point
formulas.formula: points (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂) are on the same side of ax + by + c = 0 if ax₁ + by₁ + c and ax₂ + by₂ + c have the same sign

examples.title: Lines ke beech angle
examples.problem: y = 3x + 1 aur y = x ke beech acute angle?

examples.title: Section formula
examples.problem: (1, 2) aur (7, 8) ko 2:1 mein internally divide karne wala point?

examples.title: Family of lines
examples.problem: x + y = 5 aur x − y = 1 ke intersection se guzarne wali wo line nikalo jo origin se guzarti hai.

topics.title: Locus
topics.explain: Locus nikaalne ke liye moving point ko (h, k) maano, di gayi condition ko h aur k mein equation ki tarah likho, phir h, k ki jagah x, y rakho.

topics.title: Shifting the origin
topics.explain: Origin bina rotation (h, k) par shift ho to naye coordinates X = x − h, Y = y − k. Axes ko θ se rotate karne par: x = X cos θ − Y sin θ, y = X sin θ + Y cos θ.

topics.title: Lines making a given angle
topics.explain: (x₁, y₁) se guzarne wali aur y = mx + c se angle α banane wali lines ke slopes (m ± tan α)/(1 ∓ m tan α) hain.

topics.title: Pair of straight lines
topics.explain: ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0 origin se guzarne wali do lines hai; angle tan θ = 2√(h² − ab)/|a + b|. a + b = 0 ho to perpendicular aur h² = ab ho to coincident.

topics.title: Orthocentre shortcut
topics.explain: Right-angled triangle mein orthocentre right-angle wala vertex hai aur circumcentre hypotenuse ka midpoint.

topics.title: Parametric form
topics.explain: Inclination θ wali line par (x₁, y₁) se r doori par point (x₁ + r cos θ, y₁ + r sin θ) hai — line ke saath distances ke liye kaam ka.
